segments.text: adjusting allocated costs before posting in business Central when you work with allocation accounts the split happens when the expense is posted according to the definition of your allocation accounts but what if I wanted to see or make some adjustments to the amounts that have been split

before posting there's a great function for that let's take a look at that in the general journals I search for General journals and select the search result now let's create our expense let's say this is an invoice and I want to select my allocation

account so here I have an allocation account that's called split by three it basically just splits the amount into three different accounts with an equal share let's say the amount is 10,000 now I can choose actions functions generate lines from a location account line this will now split up

just as defined in my allocation account up into these individual G accounts and now I can make any adjustments I wish to make before posting so this function is a great way to intercept or make adjustments before posting with allocation
